reels.title: 5 National Park Sunrises That Blew My Mind

reels.creator: @adventurefamilyvlog
reels.creator_name: Heather & Jesse Gariepy | Family Bucket List Travel
reels.recommendation_summary: Recommends Canyon Overlook Trail as one of Zion's best views at the end of a 1-mile trail: biggest payoff for least effort in Zion, ~160 ft gain, 1-2 hours, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, incredible at sunrise or sunset, views over Pine Creek Canyon. This place was already on the map from the @amorywild sunrise reel, so it was added as a second source on that pin instead of a duplicate pin.
reels.theme: Best short hike / best view in Zion
reels.title: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views

reels.creator: @beesforbeau
reels.creator_name: Krista Boyda (Krista and Ryan, Bees for Beau)
reels.recommendation_summary: Recommends Canyon Overlook Trail as an epic-view alternative to Angels Landing without the chains, climb or permit: about 1 mile round trip, allow about an hour, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, with sandstone formations, rock alcoves and exposed sections. Parking is very limited, arrive early. Already on the map from two earlier reels, so added as a third source on that pin.
reels.theme: Short hike with an epic view, Angels Landing alternative
reels.title: Canyon Overlook Trail — Epic View Without Angels Landing
